The '''2019–20 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Iowa]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by 10th-year head coach [[Fran McCaffery]] and played their home games at [[Carver–Hawkeye Arena]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 20–11, 11–9 in [[2019–20 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in four-way tie for fifth place. Their season ended when postseason tournaments including the [[2020 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] and the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] were canceled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/2020/03/12/coronavirus-ncaa-tournament-canceled-big-ten/5038937002/|title=March Madness cancellation inevitable, unavoidable: 'Bigger than basketball'|last=Solari|first=Chris|website=Detroit Free Press|language=en|access-date=2020-04-08}}</ref>

Forward [[Luka Garza]] was named [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://bigten.org/news/2020/3/9/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200309231733/https://bigten.org/news/2020/3/9/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 9, 2020|title=Big Ten Unveils Men’s Basketball Postseason Honors on BTN|website=[[Big Ten Conference]]|language=en|access-date=2020-04-08}}</ref> and was a [[2020 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|consensus All-American]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/iowa/basketball/garza-consensus-032420|title=Garza Is Consensus All-American|website=Maven|language=en|access-date=2020-04-08}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Hawkeyes]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 23–12, 10–10 in [[2018–19 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2018–19 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] in the second round of the [[2019 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] before losing to [[2018–19 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 10 seed in the South region. There they defeated No. 7-seeded [[2018–19 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] in the first round before losing to No. 2-seeded [[2018–19 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in the second round.
